messages:
ana-docs: Opening a small PR to recommend an 'envelope' shape for function/tool outputs in the structured-output guide. Rationale: stable parsing (always array), schema_version for future changes, and a place for metadata/provenance. Looking for compact before/after examples and tiny SDK shims (JS + Py).

ryan-ml: +1. Please call out how to handle union item types and nullable properties (use null not omission).

mike-devex: I'll add normalize() snippets for JS/Python and a unit test suggestion asserting data is always a list. Also recommend a small compatibility shim for older `result` shapes.

ana-docs: Draft example I'll put in PR body: OLD: `{ "result": {"text":"ok"} }` -> RECOMMENDED: `{ "envelope": { "kind":"tool_response", "schema_version":"1.0", "data":[{"text":"ok"}], "meta": {"model":"redwood-v2"} } }`

ci-bot: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4945 - "Recommend envelope for tool outputs" by ana-docs. Docs build passed.
